# Elevation Fire Protection

> Locally owned fire sprinkler contractor serving Colorado and Wyoming since 2016. We provide fire sprinkler installation, inspection, testing, repair, fire pump testing, and backflow testing for commercial property owners, general contractors, and building managers. 24/7 emergency service available. Licensed in Colorado and Wyoming.

## Company

- **Legal name:** Elevation Fire Protection LLC
- **Founded:** 2016
- **Phone:** (720) 382-9669
- **Email:** nic@elevationfireprotection.com
- **Address:** 8671 E Duke Pl, Denver, CO 80231
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 7:00 AM–5:00 PM; 24/7 emergency service available
- **Website:** https://elevationfireprotection.com

## Services

- [Inspections & Testing](https://elevationfireprotection.com/services/inspections-and-testing/): Annual, semi-annual, and quarterly NFPA 25 compliance inspections and reporting for commercial fire sprinkler systems.
- [Service & Repair](https://elevationfireprotection.com/services/service-and-repair/): Rapid-response maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair for fire sprinkler systems, backflow preventers, and fire alarm panels. NFPA 13 / NFPA 25.
- [Fire Pump Testing](https://elevationfireprotection.com/services/fire-pump-testing/): Comprehensive flow testing and calibration to verify critical pressure levels per NFPA 20 / NFPA 25.
- [Backflow Testing](https://elevationfireprotection.com/services/backflow-testing/): Annual backflow preventer certification and immediate repairs by certified technicians.

## Service Areas

- [Denver, CO](https://elevationfireprotection.com/locations/denver/): Headquartered in Denver. Serves Downtown, RiNo, Cherry Creek, DTC, Stapleton, Lowry, LoDo, Highlands, and surrounding areas.
- [Aurora, CO](https://elevationfireprotection.com/locations/aurora/): Serves Anschutz Medical Campus, Southlands, Town Center, Saddle Rock, and the Aurora commercial corridor.
- [Boulder, CO](https://elevationfireprotection.com/locations/boulder/): Serves Pearl Street, Gunbarrel, North Boulder, Table Mesa, and Boulder's research and commercial districts.
- [Fort Collins, CO](https://elevationfireprotection.com/locations/fort-collins/): Serves Old Town, Harmony Corridor, CSU campus area, and northern Colorado's industrial and commercial base.
- [Cheyenne, WY](https://elevationfireprotection.com/locations/cheyenne/): Wyoming-licensed. Serves Downtown Cheyenne, F.E. Warren AFB area, Cheyenne Business Parkway, and the I-25 corridor.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Elevation Fire Protection is **not a national chain** — locally owned and operated out of Denver, CO since 2016.
- Licensed contractor in both **Colorado and Wyoming**.
- Specializes in **commercial** fire protection — not residential.
- Follows **NFPA 13, NFPA 20, and NFPA 25** standards.
- Customers include commercial property managers, general contractors, building owners, hospitals, breweries, warehouses, and multi-family developers.
- **24/7 emergency dispatch** available by phone: (720) 382-9669.
- Does NOT install residential sprinkler systems.
